facts.text: I updated a letter addressed to Alex about a property.
The landlord repaired the dishwasher after coming to take a look on Monday.
I meant to send a thank you email sooner but I have been very unwell.
I found a rusty metal spike sticking out of the ground where the back gate is to be replaced.
Venkatesh told me there was construction debris back there but he did not mention hazards protruding from the ground.
My dog heard an awful shriek and I assume she stepped on the spike.
I only saw metal posts used for construction laid flat on the ground near the gate site.
I believed the construction mess was limited to the laid-flat posts because I had not been warned about dangerous protrusions from the gravel or ground.
The spike had been present for months without being noticed.
This happened while my dog was in the backyard while Venkatesh was seeing to the dishwasher.
My dog is usually not outside unattended.
I had no reason to believe there was a dangerous hazard in the area.
This experience left me scared.
My neighbors had dealt with a break-in recently.
My neighbors fortified their home after the break-in incident.
This morning we found the gate wide open.
The side gate was secured with a latch and bolted, but my personal MasterLock had not been resecured on the latch.
We woke up this morning with the side gate completely open.
The bottom bolt on the gate (the one going into the ground) was shut the night before.
It is likely that someone hopped the fence to open the gate.
If someone was casing the house, they are now aware of a decent amount of technology inside.
The technology inside includes personal computers with expensive accessories.
I want to inform Rent Select that active construction sites have been left in place so long that the sites and items are starting to decay.
I will attach photos of the front yard construction site and the backyard area where the gate is to be replaced.
The baseboard that the gate will be sitting on is showing signs of the same rot that destroyed the gate.
There has been rusty rebar for months sticking out of the ground very close to the neighbors' yard.
The actual structure Venkatesh is working to build is starting to fall apart due to weathering.
There is starting to be weed growth among the construction.
I do not feel comfortable removing the weed growth from an active construction site because of hazards such as rebar posts sticking out of the ground.

keyphrases: Rent Select construction sites left too long
